items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 August 2026 10:31pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 20 August 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the Atlantic extending a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

Northerly 3 to 5, but variable 3 or less in the east of the area, becoming north or northwest 2 to 4 in all waters tomorrow afternoon, then increasing 4 or 5 in western waters in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming smooth or slight overnight.


##Weather##

Showers, becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northerly 3 to 5, but variable 3 or less in the east of the area at first, decreasing 2 or 3 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers in the southeast at first, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
